title: The home page says Chatticus runs in an AWS account you control
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing
- **Runs in parallel with:** the rest of this epic
- **Unblocks:** the ladder story

---
Top-level positioning, not a footnote on a pricing page. The Hero and the proof strip already gesture at it — 0% lock-in, your data, your move, read the source — without ever saying the concrete thing that makes those claims true.

Say it: the organization computer runs in an AWS account you own, on your network, under your logging, and the code is MIT licensed.

**This is the message that converts the AWS requirement from an objection into the reason to choose Chatticus.** A buyer evaluating an agent product that runs a Linux computer has exactly one real fear, and every competitor answers it with a trust argument. This answers it with an account boundary.

**Done when:** the scenario exists and fails for the right reason.
